UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile stored privately for the signed-in owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

QuestionProgress.title: QuestionProgress
QuestionProgress.description: Per-question CCNA study record (medal, streak, counts, bookmark, user note) synchronized across PC and mobile.

questionId.description: CCNA question ID matching the document ID.

totalAttempts.description: Total number of attempts for this question.

lastAttemptAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds of the most recent attempt (0 if none).

lastResult.description: Result of the most recent attempt.

isBookmarked.description: Whether the question is bookmarked for review.

userNote.description: Personal study note authored by the user.

lastSelectedAnswers.description: Most recent selected answer IDs/values (max 20 items).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated.

GlobalResumeState.title: GlobalResumeState
GlobalResumeState.description: Last active study question and filter context so the user can resume from the exact question on any device.

questionId.description: Last visited or answered question ID.

answeredInVisit.description: Whether the user submitted an answer on this visit.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds timestamp for cross-device tie-breaking.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when resume document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when resume document was last updated.

ScopeResumeState.title: ScopeResumeState
ScopeResumeState.description: Per-scope (category, part, or tab) resume checkpoint for continuing partway through any filter pool.

scopeId.description: Sanitized scope identifier matching the document ID.

questionId.description: Last visited or answered question ID in this scope.

answeredInVisit.description: Whether the user submitted an answer on this visit.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds timestamp for cross-device merge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when scope checkpoint was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when scope checkpoint was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user profile document containing verified identity metadata.

/users/{userId}/progress/{questionId}.description: Owner-only per-question CCNA learning progress records synchronized across devices.

/users/{userId}/resume/global.description: Owner-only single document storing the latest global study resume checkpoint.

/users/{userId}/resumeScopes/{scopeId}.description: Owner-only per-filter-scope resume checkpoints for continuing each part or domain.
